newsitem.title: singapore: Asian dollar deposits quietly steady in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Asian dollar deposits quietly steady in late trade.

text.p: Asian dollar deposit rates were quietly steady in moderate trade, dealers said on Thursday.

They said most traders were sidelined ahead of tonight's release of the U.S. weekly jobless claims data for the week ending May 24, which are forecast to be around 321,000 compared with 322,000 reported in the previous week.
"The market was neutral today. There was not much of movement because they (traders) are waiting for Friday's figures," said a local dealer.
In day-to-day rates, Thursday/Friday and weekend were unchanged from Wednesday's common 5-5/8 5-1/2 percent, respectively.
Week-fixed rose 1/16 percentage point to 5-11/16 5-9/16 percent.

Among longer dates, two-months was unchanged from Wednesday's 5-3/4 5-5/8 percent, four-months unchanged at 5-13/16 5-11/16, six-months unchanged at 6 5-7/8 and twelve-months rose 1/16 point to 6-1/4 6-1/8 percent.
